$comment: Declared corrections of the source geometry. The Blender export applies them (packages/tools/blender/geometry_fixes.py) and reports each one in export.json; the build lists them in the coverage report and shows each note in the details of its target structures' cards ('Corrected in this atlas', a resolved geometry issue); checks.json guards the results. 'near' points are Blender world coordinates of the source (metres, Z up, -Y front) and only select the opening to work on; lengths are in metres. 'targets' are [collection, object] references like in issues.json.

fixes.reason: Z-Anatomy cuts a round teaching window (about 5 cm) into the anterior wall of the stomach; the mucosa is generated from the wall and has the same window. In the atlas it reads as a defect, and the mucosa can be seen with transparency or the surroundings level instead.

note.uk: У вихідній моделі Z-Anatomy в передній стінці шлунка та в його слизовій вирізано кругле навчальне вікно близько 5 см. Тут його закрито латкою, що продовжує кривизну стінки.
note.en: The Z-Anatomy model has a round teaching window of about 5 cm cut into the anterior wall of the stomach and its mucosa. It is closed here with a patch that continues the curvature of the wall.

fixes.reason: The oesophagus is a curve with a flat oval profile; its lower end is 3 mm off the round cardiac opening of the stomach and turned by 25°, leaving a gap of up to 5 mm.

note.uk: У вихідній моделі нижній кінець стравоходу не прилягав до кардіального отвору шлунка (щілина до 5 мм). Останні 2 см стравоходу плавно підведено до отвору.
note.en: In the source model the lower end of the oesophagus did not meet the cardiac opening of the stomach (a gap of up to 5 mm). The last 2 cm of the oesophagus are blended into the opening.

fixes.reason: The lower opening of the laryngopharynx is oblique: its posterior edge is at the upper end of the oesophagus, while its anterior part reaches down to the lower border of the cricoid cartilage 13 mm in front of the oesophagus, leaving the opening uncovered.

note.uk: У вихідній моделі нижній край гортанної частини глотки не прилягав до стравоходу (щілина до 13 мм). Край плавно підведено до поверхні стравоходу.
note.en: In the source model the lower edge of the laryngopharynx did not meet the oesophagus (a gap of up to 13 mm). The edge is laid onto the surface of the oesophagus.

fixes.reason: The small intestine is one curve in the source; its lower end stops short of the wall of the ascending colon, leaving a gap of up to 10 mm.

note.uk: У вихідній моделі нижній кінець тонкої кишки не доходив до стінки висхідної ободової кишки (щілина до 10 мм). Його плавно підведено до стінки.
note.en: In the source model the lower end of the small intestine stopped short of the wall of the ascending colon (a gap of up to 10 mm). It is blended onto the wall.

fixes.reason: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal arteries of the left kidney were modelled for a kidney the atlas does not include (CC BY-NC). With the HRA kidney in its natural orientation part of the branches lay outside it; a smooth field (pnpm data:fit) moves them inside and holds the junction with the trunk.

note.uk: Внутрішньониркові артерії Z-Anatomy змодельовано під іншу нирку. Гілки, що виходили за межі нової лівої нирки (HRA), плавно переміщено всередину неї; з'єднання зі стовбуром не змінено.
note.en: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal arteries were modelled for another kidney. The branches that lay outside the new left kidney (HRA) are moved inside it by a smooth field; the junction with the trunk is unchanged.

fixes.reason: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal veins of the left kidney were modelled for a kidney the atlas does not include (CC BY-NC). With the HRA kidney in its natural orientation part of the branches lay outside it; a smooth field (pnpm data:fit) moves them inside and holds the junction with the trunk.

note.uk: Внутрішньониркові вени Z-Anatomy змодельовано під іншу нирку. Гілки, що виходили за межі нової лівої нирки (HRA), плавно переміщено всередину неї; з'єднання зі стовбуром не змінено.
note.en: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal veins were modelled for another kidney. The branches that lay outside the new left kidney (HRA) are moved inside it by a smooth field; the junction with the trunk is unchanged.

fixes.reason: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal arteries of the right kidney were modelled for a kidney the atlas does not include (CC BY-NC). With the HRA kidney in its natural orientation part of the branches lay outside it; a smooth field (pnpm data:fit) moves them inside and holds the junction with the trunk.

note.uk: Внутрішньониркові артерії Z-Anatomy змодельовано під іншу нирку. Гілки, що виходили за межі нової правої нирки (HRA), плавно переміщено всередину неї; з'єднання зі стовбуром не змінено.
note.en: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal arteries were modelled for another kidney. The branches that lay outside the new right kidney (HRA) are moved inside it by a smooth field; the junction with the trunk is unchanged.

fixes.reason: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal veins of the right kidney were modelled for a kidney the atlas does not include (CC BY-NC). With the HRA kidney in its natural orientation part of the branches lay outside it; a smooth field (pnpm data:fit) moves them inside and holds the junction with the trunk.

note.uk: Внутрішньониркові вени Z-Anatomy змодельовано під іншу нирку. Гілки, що виходили за межі нової правої нирки (HRA), плавно переміщено всередину неї; з'єднання зі стовбуром не змінено.
note.en: The Z-Anatomy intrarenal veins were modelled for another kidney. The branches that lay outside the new right kidney (HRA) are moved inside it by a smooth field; the junction with the trunk is unchanged.

fixes.reason: The upper end of the Z-Anatomy left ureter widens into a funnel (to 7.5 mm) that met a kidney the atlas does not include; it stops 11 mm short of the outlet of the HRA renal pelvis, whose pelvi-ureteric junction narrows to about 2 mm.

note.uk: У вихідній моделі верхній кінець лівого сечоводу розширювався лійкою до ниркової миски, якої в атласі немає, і не доходив до нової миски (розрив 11 мм). Лійку прибрано, а кінець плавно підведено до виходу миски.
note.en: In the source model the upper end of the left ureter widened into a funnel towards a renal pelvis the atlas does not include and did not reach the new pelvis (a gap of 11 mm). The funnel is removed and the end is led smoothly to the outlet of the pelvis.

fixes.reason: The upper end of the Z-Anatomy right ureter widens into a funnel (to 7.5 mm) that met a kidney the atlas does not include; it stops 23 mm short of the outlet of the HRA renal pelvis, whose pelvi-ureteric junction narrows to about 2 mm.

note.uk: У вихідній моделі верхній кінець правого сечоводу розширювався лійкою до ниркової миски, якої в атласі немає, і не доходив до нової миски (розрив 23 мм). Лійку прибрано, а кінець плавно підведено до виходу миски.
note.en: In the source model the upper end of the right ureter widened into a funnel towards a renal pelvis the atlas does not include and did not reach the new pelvis (a gap of 23 mm). The funnel is removed and the end is led smoothly to the outlet of the pelvis.
